punchline: Peck says neurotics make themselves miserable while people with character disorders make others miserable, and both avoid sorting out what is theirs.
thirty_sec: Psychiatrist M. Scott Peck describes two patients. One assumes too much responsibility and thinks every conflict is his fault. The other assumes too little and blames the world. Most of us are a mix. The work is to sort out, each time, what is really ours to answer for.
